about: Hand-kept fixes for matching today's HSK words to the HSK Standard Course lessons (src/data/book.ts). Read by Topics.astro and scripts/build-topics.py. taughtAs: a word the books teach inside a longer entry that a plain search would not find (one-character words are never searched inside other entries, because one character is inside too many unrelated words). skip: words whose only match in the books is another word. 'all' holds for every level (出租 'let out' inside 出租车 'taxi', 不见 inside 不见得, and 中介 in book 3 lesson 10, which looks like a typo in the source deck); a level number holds for that level's situations only, where the word has another meaning than in the books (HSK 2 点 'order food' vs 'o'clock', HSK 3 会 'meeting' vs 'can', HSK 4 种 'to plant' vs 'kind').
